Why Aerial Measurements

Why Aerial Roof Measurements Make Sense

When speed and consistency matter, aerial measurements remove unnecessary site-visit delays and keep your estimating workflow moving.

✓No waiting for measurement appointments
✓No climbing ladders just to obtain dimensions
✓Safer, faster and easier to scale across multiple properties

Simple Workflow

How Aerial Roof Measurements Work

A straightforward process from property address to estimate-ready roof data.

01

Send the Address

Share the property location and your required report format.

02

Review Imagery

We review available aerial and supporting imagery for the property.

03

Trace the Roof

Roof facets and key linear elements are traced and measured by our team.

04

Prepare the Report

Measurements, diagrams, pitch information and waste-factor data are organized.

05

Receive Your Files

Your PDF plus requested ESX or XML deliverable is sent to you.
